item.title: The .NET Host Process: What Runs Before Main() and Why It Sometimes Hangs
item.description: This guide explores the essential role of the .NET host process, which initializes the runtime, resolves dependencies, and launches applications. It highlights common issues with lingering host processes, especially during BenchmarkDotNet runs, and offers diagnostic strategies to identify root causes, such as unclean shutdowns and locked files. Understanding this can streamline troubleshooting. Link to article: https://dotnettips.com/2026/07/05/the-net-host-process-what-runs-before-main-and-why-it-sometimes-hangs/
